capabilities: Look up English words with phonetics, definitions, and pronunciation audio
Translate selected note text with automatic Chinese-English direction detection
Fall back from built-in Youdao services to a user-configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint
Run lookup and translation from the Command Palette or editor menu
Save successful word lookups to an external vocabulary API
disambiguation: Not a general AI assistant; it only performs dictionary lookups and Chinese-English translation via Youdao and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
extras: Part of a multi-platform toolkit with Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and VS Code extensions sharing the same version; the Obsidian plugin was awaiting Community plugins approval at the time of writing, with full documentation on a separate docs site.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dictionary lookup or translation, so users must leave their note to check a word's meaning or translate selected text.

relations.evidence: Use built-in Youdao mobile services first and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint as fallback.
Configure multiple OpenAI-compatible model profiles with priority-based fallback.

summary: Dictionary lookup and translation plugin that looks up English words and translates selected note text using Youdao and OpenAI-compatible services.
